description: Analyses molecular-dynamics trajectories with a self-contained pure-numpy DCD and PDB trajectory parser plus built-in Kabsch-Sander alignment, SVD-based PCA, hierarchical clustering of RMSD matrices, geometric hydrogen-bond detection, RMSF, radius of gyration, Ramachandran analysis, inter-chain contacts and Shrake-Rupley SASA. This skill should be used when trajectory RMSD or RMSF, PCA, conformational clustering, hydrogen-bond occupancy, Ramachandran plots or solvent-accessible surface analysis is requested.
